name: hr_both
answers: We are building a data team. I want a mix: a couple of fresh graduates we can train, and a few analysts with three to six years who can lead small projects. Both groups should be comfortable with SQL and dashboards, hybrid from Bengaluru or Hyderabad, full-time. Salary depends on experience, nothing fixed yet. Hiring about five people in total, ideally within two months. Nice to have: Power BI, and healthcare domain knowledge.
notes: Both: experienced set required; Any on industry and company size builds no rule and must not turn into a specific value.
